notes.title: Axis Football 2020 v2.0 Is Now Live!
notes.content:
Axis Football 2020 v2.0 features four new, unique stadiums: Atlanta, Cincinnati, Chicago, and Nebraska. We also improved gameplay and fixed several bugs.

Official patch notes:

[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where players from non-user spectated matches were not considered when calculating players of the week awards.
[*]Players of the week will now automatically update following non-user spectated matches to show the best (so far) offensive and defensive players of the week.
[*]Fixed a bug where the final score and box score-by-quarter values did not add up to the correct amount.
[*]The pre-play menu for P2 no longer needs to be collapsed for P1 to snap the ball when playing a local player vs player match.
[*]Fixed a bug where the PAT would sometimes be skipped. (This was happening in some situations where a TD was awarded after calculating forward progress.)
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes enter into a repeated 1st down scenario when a punt was blocked or the punter was tackled before kicking the ball.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would sometimes incorrectly award the ball to the punting team when a punt was block or the punter was tackled before kicking the ball.
[*]Four new, unique stadiums have been added to the game: Atlanta, Chicago, Cincinnati, and Nebraska
[/olist]
